text:
ITEM 1 | Corn cob pieces, two bright yellow segments with cut ends, kernels regularly arranged, slight green herb garnish on one piece, sitting at upper edge of plate, about 6 cm long by 4 cm wide total, roughly 2 cm high | 60
ITEM 2 | Dark leafy greens, mostly small spiky-edged leaves with thin stems, deep green with lighter veins, slightly glossy and moist, spread across left half of plate covering about 25% of plate area, around 3 cm tall in a loose mound | 45
ITEM 3 | Fish-like fillet piece, pale greyish-tan flesh with a darker blue-grey skin edge, flaky and moist surface, dotted with small tan lentil-like grains, about 7 cm by 5 cm, roughly 1.5 cm thick, sitting in center-right of plate | 110
ITEM 4 | Small round lentil-like grains, tan to light brown, scattered over the fillet and nearby plate, matte, firm, about 0.5 cm each, forming a crumbly layer on top of the fillet | 15
ITEM 5 | Blueberries, small dark blue-black spheres with slight bloom, whole, about 1 cm diameter, scattered near the greens and at top of plate | 8
ITEM 6 | Raspberry, single red drupelet-textured berry, bright red with matte surface, about 2.5 cm across, at lower left edge of greens | 10
ITEM 7 | Small pale cubes, off-white with slightly toasted or crumbly edges, about 1 cm each, one piece sitting at lower center below fillet | 8
ITEM 8 | Scattered crumbs, small tan particles dusted across plate edge and around fillet, dry and crumbly, a few grams total | 3
ITEM 9 | Green pepper or cucumber-like strip, dark green, glossy skin, about 3 cm long, lying beside corn near top center | 6
